messages:
maya: Heads-up: AstraChip bench kickoff — target perf/W vs latency tradeoffs. Need kernel tuning + telemetry plan. @ben @alex can you lead partner handoff? TL;DR: 2-week sweep, lab + partner racks, objective = 20% perf/W improvement without >5% p99 latency regression. Details below.
ben: On it. Can you drop the test matrix? also want to know if partner allows kernel debug symbols.
maya: Matrix draft: workloads = decoder-only LLMs (2B and 7B), batch sizes [1,4,8,16], seq len 2048. Metrics = throughput (tokens/s), energy (W) via IPMI+PDU, p99 latency, KV-cache hit effect. Sweep dims: quantization (fp16,q4), kernel patch v1..v4, driver power caps 200/250/300W. I'll add runbook link: https://example.com/runbook/astra-power-economy (placeholder).
alex: We should add cold-start jitter test and prefix caching toggles. Partner asked for a sample script; I'll prep a minimal run command: 
alex: ```bash
./runbench.py --model gpt-7b --batch 8 --seq 2048 --quant q4 --kernel v2 --measure ipmi --outdir /tmp/astra-run
```
sophia: Telemetry note: need synchronized timestamps across IPMI and PDU; suggest NTP + bench-trace marker at start/end. Also capture ambient temp from rack sensors. I'll draft telemetry schema and share.
jordan: About partner access: AstraChip requires signed NDA and ephemeral SSH via jumpbox. @maya can you confirm on logistics?
maya: NDA signed last week. Partner will provide jumpbox creds on Monday. I'll coordinate with Security for runtime access and key rotation.
bench-bot: Queued job 4287: initial smoke run (AstraChip) — estimated 2h. Owner: ben. Status: scheduled.
ben: I'll run smoke Wed 08:00 PT. If smoke is green, start full sweep Thu.
alex: One ask: can we bake a kernel revert + build tag in artifacts so we can A/B easily? Suggest tag `astra-bench-v2`.
sophia: Approved. Add artifact naming: `partner-<name>-<kernel>-<quant>-<timestamp>`. I'll update the runbook.
ben: Quick question about acceptance criteria: do we want perf/W wins across all models or at least on 7B? I'd prefer a 7B focus and no regression on 2B.
maya: Decision: require >=15% perf/W win on 7B and <=3% p99 regression on 2B. If 2B regresses >3% we rollback kernel changes.
jordan: Communication plan: if we hit target, coordinate joint blog + data dump. Marketing brief needs preliminary numbers by next Friday.
maya: Noted. I'll loop in @marketing and request an embargo window for the partner announcement.
ben: 👍 Anything else? Need someone to own energy calibration on PDUs.
sophia: I'll own calibration. I'll post the calibration script and baseline wattage numbers before runs.
